# Tender response -- PKHYVA-2026-0087

## Visakoivu Oy

### Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy holds the certifications and reference track record required under Section 3. A qualifying reference is the framework agreement with Jarviseudun hyvinvointialue (public sector), EUR 1,650,000, 2021-08-01 to 2024-07-31, covering property maintenance and HVAC upkeep across five health centres -- directly comparable in scope and sector to this procurement.

### Technical response

**Fault escalation.** Unresolved faults are escalated through defined levels, with named contacts at each stage and a maximum time-to-escalation per severity class.

**Installation method statement.** Installation work under call-off orders follows a method statement covering site preparation, isolation and testing, and handover to operations.

**Lift servicing.** Elevator maintenance is carried out in accordance with the applicable statutory inspection and servicing regime.

**Spare parts.** Common spare parts are held in stock; non-stock items are sourced against a stated lead time depending on manufacturer and part class.

**Fire protection.** Fire-protection systems are serviced on a scheduled interval consistent with system type and manufacturer requirements.

**Emergency response.** Fault call-outs are answered within 4 hours of notification, supported by an on-call duty roster covering all contract properties.

**Register and documentation.** The property register and associated documentation are maintained throughout the contract and handed over in full at expiry or termination.

**Safety plan.** Work is carried out under a site safety plan consistent with our NMSB 75310 occupational health and safety management system.

### Annex A -- technical specification

The 24-month warranty on installed equipment applies as stated in Section 5.5. Electrical installations are subject to statutory periodic inspection. Condition-monitoring data is collected and reported to the contracting authority. The building automation system supports BACnet and Modbus for integration with existing systems.

### Commercial terms

Pricing is index-linked on an annual basis. The contract period is 5 years with the extension option described in Section 5. Termination follows the notice provisions in the agreement. Installed equipment carries a 24-month warranty from acceptance, as set out in Section 5.5.

### Annex B -- commercial and forms

A service-level penalty clause applies where agreed service levels are not met. The certificate of pension insurance contributions is enclosed with this tender.

### Pricing format

Prices are quoted per property with a per-m2 basis shown separately, in EUR excluding VAT, expressed as EUR/m2/year.

Visakoivu Oy confirms its intention to bid for this framework agreement.
